entries.host_element: The icon-above-caption lockup: a teal (or slate) icon centred or at the left third with a serif caption typing beneath it - 14 of the 33 compositions. The robot mascot recurs in 6 of them and is the surface the lens pushes into twice.
entries.signature: The problem → The brand answer → The feature run → Close
entries.use_when: A 45 s caption-driven feature explainer with no live UI: icon-above-caption lockups typed onto a soft vignetted bed, joined by melt-out / bare-bed / resolve cuts and x3-5 blur pushes into the icon already on screen, one cursor beat at the open, a static logo lockup to close.
tags: blur push into the element already on screen (8 of 32 joins)
melt to blur, bare bed 1-3 frames, next element arrives (9 of 32 joins)
orbit ring drawn out from an icon with robots orbiting it (twice)
dark UI card that unfolds from a slit with a teal typed pill (twice)
icon-above-caption lockup with a two-speed type-on
chromatic-aberration fringe on every dark edge
spinner that becomes a check as the payoff

entries.host_element: a white rounded card on the dark bed - the video card, the email, the dashboard, the segment card, the journey nodes are all the same object family; each scene has one, resolving in place and growing or tilting as it fills
entries.signature: A1 the moment and the late email → A2 the problem: data in five tools → A3 brand interstitial → A4 the product → A5 the promise → A6 end card
entries.use_when: A 25 s product ad on a dark bed with a fixed lens and two travelled arrivals: cards that resolve soft-to-sharp in place and type their own text, a colour sweep into a product macro that pulls back to a yawed wide card, word-pop headlines that mature from accent green to white, glitch-scramble word swaps with grey placeholder blocks, and a static photo end card.
tags: accent green as the arrival colour: words, the done-state button, the pill, the chip flash, the dashboard tint - everything lands green and cools to white
grey placeholder block standing in for a word for 1-3 frames during every headline swap
the host card tilting in 3D at its payoff (email at 4.62, dashboard at 11.04)
a green wash as the payoff emphasis (chips 6.5-6.8, dashboard 11.1-11.6)
type-on with surface growth: the container widens or grows taller with its text, no caret
one-frame joins: the film never crossfades; softness lives on the incoming side only (except the melt at 5.71)

entries.host_element: The prompt input box: wide with a placeholder (S3), then a 1.9x crop of its left end while the prompt types (S4), then the right end of the send-state input with its button and the cursor (S5). The the brand brand mark is the screen-space constant on every frame.
entries.signature: Brand title and statement → Ask: the input in three framings → Payoff: the checklist ticks itself → Closing line, the sweep begins → Cycle 2 repeats cycle 1 frame-for-frame
entries.use_when: A short looping product spot: brand title -> one-line statement -> a prompt typed into an input seen wide, then macro, then at its send button -> a checklist payoff with tick fills -> closing line. Fixed lens except one blur push per cycle; every other join is a cut, a melt + settle-in, a soft-to-sharp resolve or a colour sweep.
tags: the the brand brand mark fixed top-left on every frame, including the blue field
brand blue in three roles: whole-frame fill (statement), soft gradient bed (send + card), soft-edged sweep mass (closing -> title)
the input box as host, seen in three crops
clock-wipe tick fills, 3 frames each, ~0.3 s apart
near-white bed with a faint fine grid and slowly drifting pale squares
exits by accelerating slides; entrances by settles and sharpen-ins; the lens itself travels only for the blur push

entries.host_element: the chat thread (abby / finn): it opens the story (2.1-7.9 s) and returns for the payoff line (15.4-17.4 s) at the same big framing; the agent panel is the centre act's host and every other composition is new
entries.signature: Hook: the copy word roll → Setup: chat request → Demo: editor -> agent panel -> prompt -> reply -> count-up -> changes list → Payoff: chat the copy → CTA: two lines, word by word → End card: logo
entries.use_when: A 26 s product-demo spot on a flat black bed: chat request -> real editor UI -> one glide into an agent panel -> typed prompt -> streamed reply and linear count-up -> changes list -> chat payoff -> two CTA lines word by word -> logo; joined almost entirely by one-frame cuts (four plain, four reframes on the same surface, two leftward throws) with lateral slide exits/entrances; use it for a fixed-lens, cut-driven demo with typed prompts and text payoffs.
tags: one-frame joins as the default; the lens travels exactly once, at the moment the demo begins
push-ins by cut on the surface already on screen (chat x2.05, agent panel x2.2 twice)
leftward lateral motion as the only directional grammar: exits slide left, entrances arrive from the right
word-by-word arrival everywhere: roll, stream, count, CTA
typing dots before every chat message
white on black with the product UI as the only colour; the brand appears once, as the end card
